module: Computes the extra information shown by the minimap: remaining distance to the destination (routePlanner of core_groundMarkers), place name (highest-priority gameplay_city zone under the camera, otherwise the level title) and police pursuit state (disabled, visibleToPolice, hiddenFromPolice). Changes are sent to the 'minimap' stream via guihooks.queueStream.
notes: A single send per frame, only if a value has changed (hasNewAdditionalInfo flag).
The distance is formatted "%.1f unit" after translateDistance(…, 'auto') according to the unit settings.
checkPolice calls gameplay_police.getPursuitData() without a test: the gameplay_police extension must be available.
checkLocationName does nothing if gameplay_city is not loaded.

requestAdditionalInfo.desc: Forces the information to be resent to the 'minimap' stream at the next update (called when the interface mounts).

setVisible.desc: Shows or hides the information block in the interface; returns nothing if the value does not change. Anything that is not false is treated as true.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: checks the route, the place name and the police, then sends the info if one has changed.

onReachedTargetPos.desc: Hook called when the destination is reached: clears the distance to the target.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-level hook: empties the info (visible reset to true) and forces a resend.

onSetBigmapNavFocus.desc: Hook called when the big map's navigation focus changes; if pos is nil, clears the distance to the target.

pos.desc: Target position, or nil if the navigation is removed.
